title: Port (CONTRACT.md 4.7, operations profile)
description: A typed input or output of an operation. An in-port is also a property of the operation's MCP input schema, named for the port.

name.description: Unique within `in` and within `out`; never the name of a parameter.

type.description: `image`, `location` or one of the description's artifact_types.

many.description: The port takes or makes a non-empty list; false when absent.
